create_expression_lit_scalar: create an expression from a scalar literal value like an integer, float, string, or None
create_expression_lit_datetime: create a datetime literal expression with optional timezone and time unit conversion
create_expression_lit_series: create a literal expression from a polars Series or list of values
create_expression_lit_numpy: create a literal expression from a numpy ndarray or numpy scalar value
create_expression_lit_torch: create a literal expression from a torch tensor value
